answer_text:
If nobody on the team wants to be the CRM admin, prioritise sensible defaults, guided import and few required fields. The easiest to get running: [1]

- **Tallyfox Starter**: Simple pipelines, a mobile app people actually use and pricing from $12 per user; reporting is lighter than the big suites. [2]
- **Northwind CRM Essentials**: The safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace. [3]
- **Pipewell Go**: Pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages. [4]
- **Brightdesk**: A help desk with light CRM features — fine if support is your main workflow. [5]

In short, start with Tallyfox if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Northwind CRM if you expect to need deeper reporting.

Ledgerline's 2026 roundup ranks most of these near the top as well.
